VALUEPAIR.NAME: audit_command
VALUEPAIR.VALUE: INSERT INTO AUDIT_RUN_PP3 ( RUN_ID, MAPPING_NAME, SCD_TYPE, SOURCE_ROWS, INSERTED_ROWS, UPDATED_ROWS, REJECTED_ROWS, FILTERED_ROWS, CALCULATED_TOTAL, RECON_STATUS ) SELECT $$RUN_ID, 'm_fact_emp_pp3', 'FACT', $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.SrcSuccessRows, $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TargetSuccessRows, $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TargetUpdateRows, $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.OutputRowsRejected, $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TotalFilesFiltered, ($$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TargetSuccessRows + $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TargetUpdateRows + $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.OutputRowsRejected + $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TotalFilesFiltered), CASE WHEN $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.SrcSuccessRows = ($$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TargetSuccessRows + $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TargetUpdateRows + $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.OutputRowsRejected + $$ss_fact_emp_pp3.TotalFilesFiltered) THEN 'MATCHED' ELSE 'MISMATCHED' END FROM DUAL;
